title: Party Poppers
description: adds colorfull Party Poppers to spice up your parties
body:
**Spice up your events with colorfull confetti:**
Party Poppers is a lightweight and fun mod that adds a touch of joy to your Minecraft world. Whether you are celebrating a victory over the Ender Dragon, welcoming a new friend to your server, or just want to cause some colorful chaos, this is the mod for you!

**Requirements**

To enjoy the colorful explosions, make sure you have the following installed:
- Lodestone Lib (Required dependency for the particle effect)

**Attention**

if you use iris shaders the particles won't show up, this is a known issue with lodestone
